_comment: Four target personas. 'queries' are LinkedIn people-search keyword strings; {company} is substituted. 'notes' are tried longest-first and the first one that fits LinkedIn's 300-char invite limit wins.

hiring_manager.label: Senior technical / engineering lead
hiring_manager.why: Owns the technical team the role sits in, senior enough to refer but close enough to the work to care. The brief's primary target.
queries: "{company}" ("Head of Engineering" OR "Director of Engineering" OR "Principal Engineer" OR "Staff Engineer")
"{company}" ("D&T" OR "Digital & Technology") (Manager OR Lead OR Director)
"{company}" ("AI" OR "Automation" OR "Data") (Lead OR Manager OR Principal)
notes: Hi {first}, saw {company} is hiring {a_role}. I'm an engineer ({exp}) deliberately moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery. Would value connecting and following how your team adopts AI.
Hi {first}, saw {company_poss} {role} opening. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirements, now low-code. Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, saw {company_poss} {role} role. Engineer moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect.

recruiter_inhouse.label: In-house recruiter / TA
recruiter_inhouse.why: High accept rate and fast, but they screen on keyword fit - lead with the role name.
notes: Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role} ({location}). Engineer, {exp}: SAP/CRM requirement gathering plus low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI). Moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), SAP/CRM requirements + low-code. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI). Would love to connect.
notes_not_applied: Hi {first}, I'm interested in {company_poss} {role} ({location}). Engineer, {exp}: SAP/CRM requirement gathering plus low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI). Moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, I'm interested in {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), SAP/CRM requirements + low-code. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, interested in {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI). Would love to connect.

peer_in_role.label: Peer already in the role
peer_in_role.why: Referrals are the highest-conversion path in India. Ask about their move, never for a job in the first note.
notes: Hi {first}, you're doing the kind of {role} work at {company} I'm working toward. I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirements, now low-code - moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.
Hi {first}, you do the {role} work at {company} I'm aiming for. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.
Hi {first}, you're in the {role} work I'm aiming for. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.

agency_recruiter.label: Agency / staffing recruiter
agency_recruiter.why: Highest lead volume, lowest quality per lead. Give them your parameters up front so they filter themselves.
queries: "Business Analyst" Recruiter (Gurugram OR "Delhi NCR" OR Mumbai) staffing
notes: Hi {first}, I see you place AI/analytics talent in India. I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI) - targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles in Delhi NCR, Mumbai or remote. Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, you place AI/analytics talent in India. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles (Delhi NCR/Mumbai/remote). Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, engineer ({exp}) targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles in India. Would love to connect.

post_author.label: Author of a hiring post
post_author.why: They published the opening themselves, so they are expecting inbound and often hold the referral. Highest priority in the brief.
queries: "{company}" ("we are hiring" OR "DM me" OR "share your resume")
notes: Hi {first}, saw your post about {a_role} at {company}. I'm an engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI). I've applied; would love to connect and send my CV across.
Hi {first}, saw your post about {a_role} at {company}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), SAP/CRM requirements + low-code. I've applied - would love to connect and share my CV.
Hi {first}, saw your hiring post for {a_role}. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect.
notes_not_applied: Hi {first}, saw your post about {a_role} at {company}. I'm an engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI). Would love to connect and send my CV across.
Hi {first}, saw your post about {a_role} at {company}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), SAP/CRM requirements + low-code. Would love to connect and share my CV.
Hi {first}, saw your hiring post for {a_role}. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect.

followup_after_accept: Thanks for connecting, {first}! I'm focused on AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles - {exp} as an engineer (SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery), B.Tech CSE (AI). If something entry-level opens at {company}, I'd love to be considered - happy to send my CV.

post_searches._comment: LinkedIn CONTENT search (posts, not people). Run these first: a live hiring post beats a cold company guess, and the author is usually the person who can refer you.
technical_ownership: hiring ("technical ownership" OR "tech lead" OR "engineering manager") India
"we are hiring" ("D&T" OR "Digital & Technology") analyst India
role_match: hiring "Business Analyst" (AI OR GenAI OR automation) India
"we are hiring" "AI Analyst" OR "Automation Analyst" India
contactable: hiring analyst AI India ("share your resume at" OR "send your CV to" OR "DM me your resume")

referral_ask: Thanks for connecting, {first}! I saw {company} has an opening for {role}. I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI) - and it lines up with where I'm deliberately heading. I've attached my CV; would you be open to forwarding it to the hiring team or pointing me to the right person? Either way, thanks for connecting.

email_template.subject: Application - {role} ({company})
email_template.body:
Hi {first},

I saw your post about the {role} opening at {company} and wanted to apply directly, as you'd mentioned in it.

I'm an engineer with {exp} of experience: SAP/CRM requirement gathering and business-tech liaison work at Somany Ceramics, and currently low-code (Digia) and Flutter delivery at Primathon, turning product requirements and Figma specs into shipped features. B.Tech CSE (AI), 2024. I'm moving deliberately into AI-enabled business analysis, which is exactly what this role is.

My CV is attached. I'm based in Gurugram and open to {locations}, on a 30-day notice.

Thank you for considering it.

Best regards,
{full_name}
{phone} | {linkedin}

I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI) - moving deliberately into AI-enabled business analysis. I've attached my CV; if anything entry-level opens on your team at {company}, I'd love to be considered, or pointed to the right person. Either way, thanks for connecting.
